scope: Keep project destinations together in one toolbar
limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. No foreground OS input, Rust command integration or assistive technology verification.

conversation-desktop-dark.png.task: Open project work while keeping the current project and selected destination clear.
conversation-desktop-dark.png.observations: Project identity and six tabs form one readable row above conversation actions. Selected tab underline and text contrast are clear; body and draft retain their measure. Compact controls fit without clipping or overlap.
